title: The Unison Foundation Below All Singing

features.name: the-fundamental-resonance
features.desc-on-touch: You feel rather than hear it: a vibration in the deep stone, a single note so low it moves through your ribs. All voices singing this one frequency. The stone knows. The stone has always known.

features.name: the-root-tuning-fork
features.desc-on-touch: Pale lines converge on a point of stone. They hum. If you touch them, you find they are not lines but voices made visible, all at the same pitch, forever sustaining.

features.name: the-depth-where-all-separate-things-remember-they-are-one
features.desc-on-touch: A pool of absolute darkness, deeper than sight. The moment you look into it, you forget what individuality means. All your separate thoughts resolve into a single, patient frequency.

features.name: the-sediment-of-agreement
features.desc-on-touch: Layers of compressed stone, each layer a moment when all voices found one note together. Thousands of layers. Millions. Each one a perfect instant of unison.

inscription: where all separate voices learn they were always singing the same song

file.name: Foundation_Harmonic_Frequency_Root.mp3
file.note: The low note that holds all others. Seven voices recorded at the moment they became one. Checksum: formerly alive, now sustaining.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the stone room where all singing stopped
narr: You sit in the dark with her, both still. The recording
plays: seven voices sliding toward one note. She says,
'The merger is not a loss. Watch how they soften.' You
watch the waveform. Where they touch, light. Where light
touches, a single colour, a single frequency. She takes
your hand. The stone beneath you remembers this moment.

exits.label: eastward where the foundation splits into many voices again
westward into the stone where even the foundation has roots
